audit.why: Trundle from level 1 through first item, Yorick at two-plus items — the chart matches the packet levelChart row for row and matches the audited mirror's stated correction. No flips proposed.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 spike gave Subjugate no cooldown and described it as draining 'a huge chunk' of health.
audit.why: Subjugate is 120/100/80s and steals a percentage of the target's health, armour and magic resistance, doubling the amount stolen over 4 seconds. Eulogy of the Isles is 160/130/100 — his ultimate is back before yours at every rank, which is why six is his and why you spend Eulogy on the map instead of the duel.
audit.corrected: Subjugate is 120s at rank 1 against Eulogy's 160s, and it takes health and both resistances.

audit.whatIsWrong: Frozen Domain is labelled '(E)' in four fields — it is his W. Pillar of Ice, the actual E, is never named or given a cooldown. And King's Tribute, the passive that explains why chip damage fails in this lane, appears nowhere.
audit.why: Riot's passive text: when an enemy unit dies near Trundle he heals for a percent of its maximum health. Yorick's whole pattern is disposable summoned units fighting next to him — every Mist Walker that dies beside Trundle heals him, which is the mechanical reason the swarm loses the attrition it wins against everyone else. Frozen Domain (W, 750 range, 18s at rank 1) grants attack speed, move speed and increased healing from all sources while he stands on it, so it multiplies that passive. Pillar of Ice (E, 21s at rank 1, 1000 range) is impassable terrain that separates you from the pack.
audit.corrected: Don't let Mist Walkers die next to him — King's Tribute heals him off every unit that dies nearby. Frozen Domain is the W and amplifies all his healing on the zone; Pillar of Ice is the E, 21s at rank 1, and it is what cuts you off from your own swarm.

audit.whatIsWrong: The early-game line tells you to 'farm with Q Last Rites' execute range'.
audit.why: Last Rites has range 0 — it is a melee auto-attack empower with a heal and an auto reset, not a ranged execute. The advice as written sends the player to last-hit at a range the ability does not have.
audit.corrected: Last Rites is a melee auto-reset that heals you; use it on the wave and keep Mist Walkers between you and Chomp.

edits.before: Trundle's spike, not yours: his Chomp (Q) bite steals your AD and heals him off every trade, and his Frozen Domain (E) zone gives him move speed and attack speed to stick and out-sustain your Q Last Rites. Don't melee-brawl him on his terms; use Mourning Mist (E) to slow-poke and reset.
edits.after: Trundle's spike, not yours: Chomp (Q, 3.5s) saps your AD, and King's Tribute heals him whenever a unit dies near him — your own Mist Walkers included. Frozen Domain (W, 750 range) amplifies all his healing while he stands on it. Never brawl on the zone; Mourning Mist and reset.

edits.before: At 2 his sustain and Frozen Domain (E) zone keep him ahead in extended pokes.
edits.after: At 2 his sustain and Frozen Domain (W) keep him ahead in extended pokes.

edits.before: Trundle wins levels 1-2 flat out: Chomp (Q) bites your AD off and heals him, so any auto-trade leaves you weaker and him fuller. Farm with Q Last Rites' execute range, use ghouls from Shepherd of Souls to soak minion damage, and don't stand in his Frozen Domain (E).
edits.after: Trundle wins levels 1-2 flat out: Chomp (Q) saps your AD and heals him, so any auto-trade leaves you weaker and him fuller. Last Rites is a melee auto-reset that heals you — use it on the wave, keep Mist Walkers between you, and never stand on Frozen Domain (W).

edits.before: Levels 3-6 stay Trundle-favoured because his E zone lets him chase and his sustain outlasts your poke, and his R Subjugate at 6 can win any extended fight by stripping your stats. Hold the W Dark Procession cage for when he commits Chomp, and prioritize wave-clearing over dueling until you have items.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 stay Trundle-favoured: Frozen Domain (W) lets him chase and amplifies his healing, and Subjugate at 6 on 120s strips a share of your health and both resistances. Pillar of Ice (E, 21s, 1000 range) is what splits you from your pack — hold Dark Procession for after it, and clear waves rather than duel.

edits.after: Early all-ins on his Frozen Domain (W) speed zone

edits.before: Raise 3-4 ghouls, E-mark Trundle so they leap, W-cage the retreat, and AA alongside the swarm — the ghouls out-damage you both.
edits.after: Raise 3-4 Mist Walkers, Mourning Mist him so they sprint in, Dark Procession his retreat, and AA alongside the swarm.

edits.before: - Trundle Subjugate: matchup-defining — Steals your stats. Swarm when it’s down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Subjugate: 120s at rank 1 — it steals a share of your health and both resistances, doubled over 4s. - Pillar of Ice (E): 21s at rank 1, 1000 range, impassable terrain that cuts you off your pack. - Eulogy: kill windows only.

edits.after: King's Tribute heals him whenever a unit dies near him — your dying Mist Walkers feed it too.

notes: King's Tribute is the finding that matters: Yorick is close to the worst possible opponent for a passive that heals off nearby unit deaths, and the page never mentioned it once. The Frozen Domain slot error (labelled E in four places when it is the W, with the real E never named) meant the page's 'don't stand in his zone' advice pointed at the wrong ability for anyone checking their cooldown bar.
